question: Does embodiment or its absence make any real difference for one non-different from Śiva?
premises: The liberated person rejects identification with the universe-form.
The liberated person is non-different from Śiva.
Embodiment and absence of embodiment are both considered.
inference: For one non-different from Śiva, there is no essential distinction between having a body and not having a body.
plain_english: Therefore, for one who has rejected the universe-form and is non-different from Śiva, there is indeed no distinction whether in the body or even in its absence.
